steps: Hang from the bar with hands a bit wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back before you bend your arms.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, driving your elbows toward your ribs.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Kicking or swinging to get up
Craning the neck to reach the bar

steps: Hang with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your legs still.
Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin is over it.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Set the counterweight, kneel on the pad and grip the handles wide.
Pull your elbows down to your sides until your chin passes the handles.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Using so much assistance the last reps are easy

steps: Grip the bar a bit wider than your shoulders, thighs locked under the pad.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the bar to your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back.
Let it rise slowly, about 2 seconds, until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Swinging your body back to move the weight
Pulling the bar behind your neck
Shrugging your shoulders up at the top

steps: Attach a V-handle and sit with thighs under the pad.
Lean back a little with your chest up.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, elbows close to your body.
Return slowly until your lats are fully stretched.
mistakes: Leaning far back and rowing instead
Letting the weight yank your arms up

steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are just within reach.
Pull the handles down until they reach chest level.
Squeeze your lats for a second at the bottom.
Return slowly to full stretch.
mistakes: Cutting the stretch short at the top

steps: Stand facing a high cable with a straight bar or rope, arms almost straight.
Hinge slightly forward and brace your core.
Sweep the bar down to your thighs in an arc, keeping elbows soft but fixed.
Return slowly to shoulder height.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a pushdown

steps: Sit with feet on the platform and a wide bar in an overhand grip.
Sit tall with a slight bend in the knees.
Row the bar to your lower chest, elbows out at about 45 degrees.
Squeeze your shoulder blades for one second, then extend slowly.
mistakes: Letting the shoulders roll forward at the end

steps: Sit with a V-handle, knees slightly bent and chest up.
Pull the handle to your belly, elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Let your arms extend fully without rounding your back.
Place one knee and hand on a bench, back flat.
Hold the dumbbell with a straight arm under your shoulder.
Pull it toward your hip, keeping the elbow close.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
mistakes: Pulling toward the chest instead of the hip

steps: Hinge forward to about 45 degrees with a flat back, bar hanging at your knees.
Brace your core and keep your knees soft.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower it under control without standing up.
Straddle the bar and grip the handle with a flat back.
Hinge at the hips with chest up.
Pull the handle to your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
mistakes: Using the legs to heave the weight

steps: Lie chest-down on the pad and grip the handles.
Keep your chest on the pad the whole set.
Pull the handles back until your elbows pass your torso.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad

steps: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Sit tall with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly to straight arms.
Lie under a bar set at hip height and grip it overhand.
Keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest up to the bar.
Lower until your arms are straight.
Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hands just outside your legs.
Flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close.
Lower by pushing your hips back, then bending your knees.
mistakes: Bar drifting away from the legs
Jerking the bar off the floor

steps: Set the bar on pins just below your knees.
Grip it with a flat back and chest up.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Lower it back to the pins under control.
Set the pad just below your hips and hook your feet.
Cross your arms or hold a plate on your chest.
Lower your torso by bending at the hips with a flat back.
Rise until your body is in a straight line, no higher.
mistakes: Rounding the back on the way down

steps: Place a light bar on your upper back, knees soft.
Push your hips back and lower your chest with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.
Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for one second at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Hold the bar at your thighs with a shoulder-width grip.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Pause, then lower under control.
Set a rope at face height and grip it with thumbs toward you.
Step back so the stack lifts, arms straight.
Pull the rope toward your eyes, hands ending beside your ears.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Leaning back to move more weight

steps: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press it back up over your shoulders.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest
Lifting the hips off the bench

steps: Set the bench to about 30 degrees.
Grip slightly wider than shoulders, shoulder blades pinched.
Lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press up and slightly back over your shoulders.
mistakes: Losing the arch in the upper back

steps: Lock your legs in on a decline bench.
Unrack with straight arms over your chest.
Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press back up.
Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells at chest level.
Press them up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched throughout.
mistakes: Clanking the dumbbells at the top
Dropping too low and losing shoulder position

steps: Set the bench to 30 degrees and sit back with dumbbells on your thighs.
Kick them up to your shoulders.
Press up and slightly together.
Lower slowly to upper-chest level.
mistakes: Bench too steep, turning it into a shoulder press

steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with your mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your back against the pad.
mistakes: Letting the stack touch between reps

steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at upper-chest height.
Press up and forward to straight arms.
Return slowly to a full stretch.
Set both pulleys at shoulder height and step forward into a split stance.
Start with arms wide and elbows slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a hugging arc.
Return slowly until you feel the stretch.
mistakes: Turning it into a press by bending the elbows
Using too much weight to control

steps: Set both pulleys low and hold the handles with a slight elbow bend.
Sweep your hands up and together to shoulder height.
Squeeze the upper chest.
Lower back slowly.
Set the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch.
mistakes: Letting the arms go too far back
Pushing with the hands instead of hugging

steps: Set the seat so the handles start at lower-chest height.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Bring the handles together and slightly down.
Return slowly to a full stretch.
mistakes: Going too heavy and losing control

steps: Lie on a bench with dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in.
Lower them out wide with a slight elbow bend.
Stop when you feel a deep chest stretch.
Bring them back together in the same arc.
mistakes: Going too deep with heavy weight

steps: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Push back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Going too deep and straining the shoulders

steps: Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to just above the floor.
Push back up to straight arms.
Set the bench so the bar lowers to your mid-chest.
Unhook the bar with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower it to your chest under control.
Press back up.
Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand in a split stance and brace.
Press the bar up and forward to straight arms.
Lower it back to your chest.
Do 10 slow arm circles forward and 10 backward.
Hold a light band at shoulder height and pull it apart 15 times.
Finish with 10 band dislocates, arms straight.
mistakes: Using a band that is too heavy

steps: Hold the bar at your collarbones, hands just outside your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back out of the way.
Finish with the bar over your mid-foot, then lower to your chest.
mistakes: Pressing the bar forward instead of up

steps: Sit on a bench with the back upright, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press them up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to ear level.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the pad

steps: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Letting the stack bounce at the bottom

steps: Start with dumbbells at chin height, palms facing you.
Rotate your palms forward as you press up.
Reverse the rotation on the way down.
Stand with dumbbells at your sides, slight bend in the elbows.
Raise them out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows, pinkies level with thumbs.
Lower slowly.
Set a pulley at the lowest point and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, arm slightly bent.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly. Do all reps on one side, then switch.
Sit with the pads against the outside of your upper arms.
Raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise them straight forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Face away from a low pulley with the handle between your legs.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells under your chest.
Raise them out to the sides with soft elbows.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Using the traps instead of rear delts

steps: Sit facing the pad with the handles at shoulder height.
Push the handles back in a wide arc with soft elbows.
Squeeze your rear delts for a second.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Pulling the shoulder blades together too much

steps: Cross the cables at shoulder height and grab opposite handles.
Pull your arms out wide in an arc.
Return slowly.
Hold a bar at your thighs with a shoulder-width grip.
Pull it up along your body, elbows leading.
Stop at lower-chest height, then lower slowly.
Stand with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press them up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.
mistakes: Clanking the weights at the top

steps: Stand holding a bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up to chest height.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Hold the EZ-bar on the angled grips, arms straight.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Curl the bar up until your forearms are vertical.
Lower slowly, about two seconds.
mistakes: Cutting the bottom of the rep short

steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl both up, keeping elbows still.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Turning the curl into a front raise

steps: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl them up without turning your wrists.
Lower slowly.
Set a bench to 45–60 degrees and lie back with arms hanging.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing down.
Curl the dumbbells up.
Lower all the way for a full stretch.
mistakes: Lifting the shoulders off the bench

steps: Sit with the backs of your arms flat on the pad.
Curl the handle up to just short of vertical.
Lower slowly to almost straight arms.
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad

steps: Stand facing a low pulley with a straight bar or rope.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up to chest height.
Lower under tension.
Sit and brace your elbow against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly. Do all reps, then switch arms.
Face away from a low pulley with the handle in one hand behind you.
Step forward so your arm is pulled back.
Curl the handle forward and up.
Lower slowly to the full stretch.
Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging.
Curl the dumbbells up.
Squeeze, then lower slowly.
Set the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot.
Curl the handles up.
Lower slowly.
Hold a bar with an overhand grip.
Curl it up with elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly.
Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip it with thumbs up.
Pin your elbows at your sides.
Push down and spread the rope at the bottom.
Let your forearms rise to about 90 degrees.
Grip a straight or V-bar at a high pulley, elbows at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze, then let it rise slowly to chest height.
Face away from the pulley holding a rope behind your head.
Stagger your feet and lean slightly forward.
Extend your arms forward and up until straight.
Return slowly for a deep stretch.
Lie on a bench holding an EZ-bar above your chest.
Bend only at the elbows, lowering the bar toward your forehead.
Extend back up to straight arms.
Lie on the bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width.
Lower it to your lower chest, elbows tucked.
Press back up.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lower it behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend back up.
Place your hands on a bench behind you, legs out front.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Push back up.
Hold a single handle at a high pulley.
Pin your elbow at your side.
Extend your arm down until straight.
Return slowly. Switch arms after the set.
Set the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot.
Push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.

steps: Hinge forward with your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your forearm back until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly.
Place your hands together under your chest, forming a diamond.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest to your hands, then push up.
Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Let the dumbbell roll to your fingers.

Lower slowly.

Pick up heavy dumbbells with a tight grip.

Walk with short, steady steps for the set distance or time.

steps: Rest the bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width.
Brace your core and break at the hips and knees together.
Sit down until your hips are at or below your knees.
Drive up through your whole foot.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom

steps: Rest the bar on your front shoulders, elbows high.
Squat down keeping your torso upright.
Drive back up, leading with your chest.
Sit with your back flat and feet shoulder-width on the platform.

mistakes: Lower back lifting off the seat
Locking the knees at the top

steps: Stand on the platform with your back on the pad, feet shoulder-width.
Release the safeties and lower until your thighs are parallel or deeper.
Drive back up through your feet.
Set the bar on your upper back with feet slightly forward.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Press back up.
Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down between your knees, chest up.
Drive back up.
Stand a stride in front of a bench and rest your back foot on it.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive up through your front heel. Switch legs after the set.

steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push off and step through into the next lunge.
Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Step back and lower your back knee.
Push through your front heel to return.
Stand facing a box or bench.
Step up with one foot and drive through that heel.
Step down slowly. Alternate legs or finish one side.
Sit with the pad on your lower shins and knees at the pivot.
Straighten your legs fully.
Squeeze your quads for a second.
Lower slowly.

steps: Lie face down with the pad above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly.
Sit with the lap pad snug on your thighs and the leg pad above your heels.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.

Hold the bar at your thighs, knees soft.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, back flat.

steps: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.
